title: Keep previously paged test-run aliases after live restoration and later snapshot omission
outcome: A previously loaded alias restored by live updates remains in panel-local loaded history when the live snapshot later omits it; live-only identities do not become unbounded global history.
acceptance: A deterministic UI regression loads alias B, supersedes it with canonical C, restores B without fetching B again, then omits B from live data and proves B remains visible in loaded history.
The fix preserves canonical deduplication, explicit restoration, project/unmount stale guards and panel-local ownership without automatically loading or accumulating all history.
